decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established sheet-handling and modular automation knowledge, and its continued dedicated presentation over two years indicates the firm can interpret and use early results, making a drop unlikely.

The folding add-on unit is closely related to the firm's core folding and modular system capabilities, and the reported customer application of combined creasing, perforating, cutting, and folding supports the firm's ability to assimilate and improve it, so dropping is unlikely.
